Varoom

Steel Poison

Paldea · Generation 9

Varoom is a Steel/Poison-type Single-Cyl Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 35 kg. It evolves into Revavroom. Its highest base stat is Attack (70), with a base stat total of 300.
